Processing Rules: If the data is masked by all asterisks, the data is neither displayed nor printed.
Character Type: N Maximum Length: 1 byte

Purpose: Identifies the number of times the subsequent phone number in Data Segment No. DL2, Dial String Data Segment, can be redialed.
Valid Codes/Values: 1–3
Character Type: N Maximum Length: 18 bytes
Representation: Variable length of up to 18 digits
Purpose: Identifies the primary, secondary, or tertiary (assigned, but not used) Phone Number used in transaction dialing.
Character Type: N Maximum Length: 1 byte
Processing Rules: Fixed value: 1
1 Transaction dial strings
Representation: Fixed length of one alphanumeric character
A Indicates the end of the first dial string in the Dial String Data Segment (Data Segment No. DL2).
F Indicates the end of the second dial string in the Dial String Data Segment (Data Segment No. DL2).
Character Type: AN Maximum Length: 12 bytes
Representation: Variable length of up to 12 alphanumeric characters

Processing Rules: If Access Code information is not necessary, the dial string contains neither this element nor the Pause Indicator that immediately follows it; however, this element may be used to indicate a much longer than standard pause for use with phone systems that are slow to provide a dial tone.
In these cases, one or more B characters may be inserted in this element. Each one should be interpreted as a 1-second pause.
Character Type: AN Maximum Length: 1 byte
Representation: Fixed length of one alphanumeric character
Valid Codes/Values: B
Character Type: N Maximum Length: 4 bytes
Representation: Fixed length 4-digit number (HHMM)

Processing Rules: For devices that use an automatic cut time, the device should start the settlement procedure 30 minutes prior to the merchant’s cut time if the settlement has not been completed by the clerk for that business day.
